e.title: insurance-deploy
e.summary: UK 保险定价部署框架（burning-cost）：champion/challenger + 模型注册 + 报价路由 + 审计
e.body: insurance-deploy（PyPI v0.1.6，burning-cost）是 UK 保险定价部署框架：champion/challenger 定价（新旧模型对比上线）、模型注册、报价路由、ENBP 审计日志与统计提升——定价模型的工程化上线。对 RIAA：定价模型「从实验到生产」的工程框架——与 [[haute]]（定价引擎）、[[insurance-mlops]]（MLOps 流程）、[[mlflow]]（模型注册）配套：部署层 + 引擎层 + 流程层；理解「定价模型怎么上线/怎么验证提升」（champion/challenger 是精算定价的核心实践）；burning-cost 家族的部署篇（配 [[insurance-pricing-course]] 的学习路径）。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.1.6 + burning-cost 仓库确认（champion/challenger 定价部署框架），未实测
e.summary_en: UK insurance pricing-deployment framework (burning-cost): champion/challenger + model registry + quote routing + audit
e.summary_hk: UK 保險定價部署框架（burning-cost）：champion/challenger + 模型註冊 + 報價路由 + 審計
e.body_en: insurance-deploy (PyPI v0.1.6, burning-cost) is a UK insurance pricing-deployment framework: champion/challenger pricing (new-vs-old model rollout), model registry, quote routing, ENBP audit logging and statistical uplift — engineering the go-live of pricing models. For RIAA: an engineering framework taking pricing models from experiment to production — with [[haute]] (pricing engine), [[insurance-mlops]] (MLOps processes) and [[mlflow]] (model registry) it forms deployment + engine + process layers; understand how pricing models go live and how uplift is validated (champion/challenger is a core actuarial pricing practice); the deployment chapter of the burning-cost family (with the [[insurance-pricing-course]] learning path).
e.body_hk: insurance-deploy（PyPI v0.1.6，burning-cost）是 UK 保險定價部署框架：champion/challenger 定價（新舊模型對比上線）、模型註冊、報價路由、ENBP 審計日誌與統計提升——定價模型的工程化上線。對 RIAA：定價模型「從實驗到生產」的工程框架——與 [[haute]]（定價引擎）、[[insurance-mlops]]（MLOps 流程）、[[mlflow]]（模型註冊）配套：部署層 + 引擎層 + 流程層；理解「定價模型怎麼上線/怎麼驗證提升」（champion/challenger 是精算定價的核心實踐）；burning-cost 家族的部署篇（配 [[insurance-pricing-course]] 的學習路徑）。
